newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Globe to invest $86 mln in phone lines.
newsitem.headline: Globe to invest $86 mln in phone lines.

text.p: Globe Telecom GMCR Inc said on Monday it would invest $86.812 million for the installation of telephone lines in the southern island of Mindanao,

The company said it will install 72,720 lines this year in Mindanao. The $86.812 million investment also includes the cost of interconnection with dominant carrier Philippine Long Distance Telephone Co and other networks.

Globe, owned by Philippine conglomerate Ayala Corp and Singapore Telecom Inc, is a cellular phone operator. But its licensing conditions also require it to install 700,000 telephone lines within a three-year period or by 1998. - Manila newsroom 63 2 8418939 fax 8176267
